headline: Public hearing on a side setback variance request for an addition at 359 Carter Avenue.
summary: The applicant asks for a dimensional variance to build a 480 square foot addition at 359 Carter Avenue. The request includes a 4 foot side setback where an 8 foot setback is required.
items: Luis Medeiros, applicant and owner, requests a dimensional variance under Section 410-44 of the Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance
Property at 359 Carter Avenue, Tax Assessors Plat 16 Lots 91 and 94, in an RS Residential Single Family Zone
Proposed 480 square foot addition to the western side of the existing structure
Proposed 4 foot side setback where an 8 foot setback is required
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, 2nd floor, Pawtucket, RI 02860

Luis Medeiros applicant and
 
owner of the property at 359 Carter Avenue further
identified as Tax Assessors Plat 16 Lots 91 and 94 located in an “RS” Residential Single
Family Zone is requesting a Dimensional Variance under Section 410-44 of the
Pawtucket Zoning Ordinance. The applicant is proposing to construct a 480 square foot
addition to the western side of the existing structure where a 4 foot side setback is
proposed where an 8 foot setback is required. - FOR PUBLIC HEARING AND FOR
